name: eBay used V100 32GB SXM2 + PCIe adapter + fan bundle

notes: The pragmatic middle path on SXM2: sellers now ship pre-assembled module+adapter+fan bundles, pricing the adapter+labour at ~$200-340 over the bare module ($349-800 bare vs $840-1,140 bundle). Cheaper than a native PCIe card ($695-900) only at the low end of the bundle band.
